name: Shorty's
architects: Rod Whitman, Dave Axland and Keith Cutten (2024)

dtm.source: DOGAMI lidar DIGITAL_TERRAIN_MODEL_MOSAIC (bare earth), probably the OLC South Coast project flown 2008 (as for the other Bandon courses; to confirm on arrival), exportImage at 1 m in EPSG:32610, box x 386050-387300 / y 4780850-4782700 shared by Shorty's and Bandon Preserve (GitHub release bandon-par-threes-data). Downloaded by the developer 2026-10-22: exportImage.12.tiff (1,250 x 1,850, float32, feet, no nodata).

chm.source: DOGAMI lidar CANOPY_HEIGHT_MODEL_MOSAIC, same project and shared box (GitHub release bandon-par-threes-data). Downloaded by the developer 2026-10-22: exportImage.13.tiff (feet, 0-120 ft).
chm.label: DOGAMI canopy height model

ortho.source: Oregon Statewide Imagery Program 2024 (OSIP_2024_WM), one exportImage JPEG at 0.5 m, box x 386050-387300 / y 4780850-4782700, shared by Shorty's and Bandon Preserve (GitHub release bandon-par-threes-data). Downloaded by the developer 2026-10-22: exportImage.jpg (2,500 x 3,700 px), georeferenced from the request bbox by make_ortho.py.

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (304 x 804 m, way 1540940976) + at least 120 m of scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred (232 m west/east, 238 m south/north)

scorecard_source: Bandon Dunes Golf Resort scorecard dated 2024-03-13 (2024-Shortys-Scorecard-3-13-24.jpg, GitHub release bandon-par-threes-data, sha256 07edc9f653f60b9e65125c2cfe48855d0ba88d9fb876f50947eabde488a3ed61, read 2026-10-22). Back, Middle, Front and Putting tee columns; every column adds up to its printed total (1,997 / 1,673 / 1,309 / 979). The card prints no par row (all 19 holes are par 3: First Call Golf 2024-05-11, GCA) and no stroke index, so handicap is stored as 0 (open item). No rating. Yardages are to the centre of the green (card). Built from the Back tees (no Blue; the longest set). Card note: environmentally sensitive areas (red stakes, green tops) are mandatory relief without penalty; not modelled.
attribution: Elevation and canopy: Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI) lidar
Orthophoto: Oregon Statewide Imagery Program 2024 (gorse, tree and tee checks)
Scorecard: Bandon Dunes Golf Resort (club scorecard)
notes: Intake 2026-10-22 (built with Bandon Preserve from shared downloads, release bandon-par-threes-data). Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1): back tees (no Blue), all water red, OB = the OSM course polygon, trees from lidar with trees_off_fairways_m 2; wind 8-16 mph as the developer set for Bandon Dunes; theme bandon_dunes with gorse from the 2024 photo, as at Bandon Dunes. Provisional until the rasters arrive; lake_level_max_m / cliff keys copied from Old Macdonald, to be checked against this DTM.
tree_type_note: the trees on the bluffs at Bandon are shore pine (and Sitka spruce in the hollows), whose broad wind-flattened crowns the crown-shape rule calls deciduous; the broadleaf scrub is drawn as gorse (as at Bandon Dunes)

gorse.note: as at Bandon Dunes (developer 2026-10-20): thickets from the OSIP 2024 orthophoto (pipeline/gorse.py); the ground under them is the gorse surface (17)

trees_need_ortho.note: the DOGAMI lidar here was flown in 2008, older than parts of the course; lidar trees whose crowns are not dark canopy in the OSIP 2024 photo are dropped
